name: I became the King of Hell, and took control of the Book of Life and Death
original_name: 转职阎王，我执掌了生死簿
overview: Li Yi breaks through the job restrictions and advances to become the Fengdu Emperor, and finally quells the war through a decisive battle, restoring peace to the planetThe animation, through its grand setting of the underworld system fighting against alien races, showcases the protagonist's growth process of controlling life and death and protecting the common people
